skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of marketing, online marketing, and digital marketing.
Analyze and explain various forms of online marketing and their practical applications.
Develop and manage websites and online stores, optimizing for search engines.
Utilize SEO techniques to optimize websites and improve search engine rankings.
Analyze digital marketing scenarios and use IT tools to support marketing activities.
Plan, design, and implement online marketing systems.
Work independently or collaboratively in teams, demonstrating organizational and social responsibility.
Identify and solve marketing problems using digital tools and techniques.
Communicate effectively in marketing contexts, both individually and in groups.
Apply critical thinking to marketing scenarios and digital marketing strategies.
Read and understand marketing literature and digital marketing concepts.
Demonstrate professional ethics in the field of information systems management.
Use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL Server, and PHP for web development.
